meta.entry: limit at mult*CVDD(t-lag); fill if exchange daily low <= limit; fill=min(limit, open)
meta.drawdown: fill -> lowest daily low until next cycle top (ongoing: until now)
meta.stress: lows replaced by worst low across bitstamp/coinbase/binance each day, entry still on named exchange
meta.leverage_model: isolated linear long, taker fee 0.0005, maintenance margin 0.005, funding 0.0003/day of notional paid every day held (conservative, ignores negative funding), liquidation checked on daily low
caveats: exchanges liquidate on mark/index price (multi-exchange average), so single-exchange spot lows are harsher than real liquidation triggers
derivative last-trade wicks (e.g. BitMEX 2020-03-13) can be deeper than spot; BitMEX data blocked, not included
cvdd for day t is computed from day t close, so lag 0 uses information not available intraday
meta.summary_rule: lag1, cycles 2015-2022, only exchanges listed before that cycle bottom

skipped_cycles.2011-06-08: bitstamp 2011 data too thin (daily low 2.50 on bottom day vs Mt.Gox-era 2.05), excluded

etf_meta: daily rebalanced, bitstamp UTC close-to-close every calendar day, expense 0.0185/yr + financing 0.05/yr on (L-1); entry at first close <= mult*CVDD(t-1)
